## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public API, CLI, OpenAPI, package, or VEIL receipt contract change
- [ ] Compatibility change documented, including upgrade and rollback behavior
- [ ] Versioning and CHANGELOG impact assessed

## Risk Review

- [ ] Tenant isolation, authentication, idempotency, and audit impact assessed
- [ ] Evaluation target egress, secret redaction, and fixture safety assessed
- [ ] Security disclosure or operational runbook impact assessed

## Verification

List the commands, CI evidence, and any migration or package dry-run evidence.

## Release Impact

- [ ] No release action required
- [ ] Release evidence, SBOM/provenance, and rollback notes updated
